# Zelda 64 Player — LLM Context File

## Project Overview
**Zelda 64 Player** is a native Android (Kotlin) emulator frontend for fan-made Nintendo 64 Zelda ROM hacks (Ocarina of Time, Majora's Mask). Users provide their own legally-owned base ROMs; the app applies BPS/IPS patches on-the-fly and plays them via Libretro cores (mupen64plus-next GLES3 and parallel-n64). No ROMs are embedded or distributed.

**Website:** https://zonaro.github.io/zelda64player/
**Repository:** https://github.com/zonaro/zelda64player
**License:** GPL-3.0 (derivative of Ludere)

---

## Key Features

### Hack Store & Catalog
- GitHub-hosted JSON catalog with 20+ Zelda 64 hacks
- Multi-catalog merge support with ETag caching for incremental updates
- Background catalog refresh via WorkManager (12-hour periodic)
- Each hack entry includes: metadata, base ROM requirements, patch URL/checksums, compatible cores, tags, cover art

### On-the-Fly Patching
- Live BPS and legacy IPS patching at launch time
- Triple CRC32 validation: source ROM checksum, patch checksum, target ROM checksum after patch
- Pure Kotlin patcher module (no Android dependencies) — clean-room implementation from public BPS spec
- N64 byte-order normalization (.z64/.v64/.n64 → big-endian .z64)

### Base ROM Management
- Checksum-based matching using gameCode + versionByte + CRC32/MD5/SHA1
- Users import their own OoT/MM ROMs via Settings → Import Base ROM
- Vanilla base ROMs playable directly from Library screen (no patches needed)
- Isolated storage per hack: `rom_<hackId>`, `sram_<hackId>`, `state_<hackId>`

### Auto-Ocarina
- In-game HUD that auto-plays Ocarina songs from pause menu
- Built-in catalog: OoT (12 songs), MM (11 songs)
- Optional per-hack custom songs via catalog `ocarinaSongs` field
- Coroutine sequencer sends key events to GLRetroView (~330ms/note)
- Cancellable by user input, menu open, or lifecycle changes
- Game detection via `RomHeader.gameCode` prefix: `CZL*` = OoT, `NZL*`/`NSM*` = MM

### RetroAchievements Integration
- Sign in with RetroAchievements.org account
- Achievements tracked during play with unlock popups, challenge/progress indicators
- Leaderboards accessible only via in-game menu (never overlaid on gameplay)
- RA hash computed exclusively from final patched ROM at install time
- Credentials stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences (`ra_secure_prefs`), never logged
- Hardcore mode defaults OFF until RAdmin User-Agent validation
- System notifications opt-in (requires POST_NOTIFICATIONS on API 33+)

### Nintendo Switch-Style UI
- Custom native implementation inspired by Nintendo Switch HOME menu (NS_Launcher/FLauncher reference)
- Dark theme: bg #2D2D2D, green accent #02830C, cyan focus, amber actions
- Library Home: horizontal cover carousel (13:9 ratio), focused game label, profile entry, colored dock
- Settings: landscape sidebar / portrait drawer with scrim
- RadialGamePad touch layout FROZEN (measured for OoT/MM) — only chrome restyled
- CC0/synthesized sound effects (focus-move, select, back, panel open/close)

### Screen Capture, Recording & Gallery
- Screenshots via PixelCopy (with/without overlay)
- Video recording via MediaProjection (MP4, toggle for including controls)
- Switch-style gallery to view, share, delete captures
- Media stored locally only (no upload/telemetry)

### Internationalization
- pt-BR (default), English, Spanish
- All user-facing strings in `strings.xml` (zero hardcoded strings)

---

## Technical Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|------------|
| Language | Kotlin 1.9+ (JVM target 1.8) |
| Min SDK | Android API 24 |
| Target/Compile SDK | Android API 35 |
| Build System | Gradle 8.x (Kotlin DSL) |
| Architecture | MVC-ish (Activity+ViewBinding → ViewModel → Repository) |
| DI | Manual Service Locator (`AppContainer`) |
| Emulation | LibretroDroid 0.13.2 (vendored module) |
| Touch Controls | RadialGamePad 0.6.0 (frozen package) |
| Networking | OkHttp 4.12+ |
| Image Loading | Coil 2.6.0 |
| Persistence | JSON files + EncryptedSharedPreferences |
| Coroutines | kotlinx-coroutines 1.8+ |
| Background Tasks | WorkManager 2.9.0 |
| RetroAchievements | rcheevos ~12.x (MIT, ANSI C, JNI bridge) |
| UI Toolkit | Custom Switch-inspired skin (Material Components 1.14.0 as technical base) |
| Testing | JUnit 5, MockK, Turbine |

## Project Structure (Key Packages)

```
br.com.redclaw.zelda64player
├── data/model/           # BaseRom, HackEntry, HackCatalog, PatchFile, Checksums
├── data/local/           # BaseRomRepository, PatchRepository, CatalogRepository, SaveBackupManager
├── patcher/              # PURE KOTLIN (no Android deps)
│   ├── bps/              # BPS parser, applier, validator, varint
│   ├── ips/              # IPS applier (legacy)
│   ├── n64/              # RomNormalizer, RomHeader, ChecksumCalculator
│   └── PatcherFacade.kt  # applyPatch API with BPS/IPS auto-detection
├── store/                # Hack Store feature
│   ├── ui/               # StoreActivity, ViewModel, Adapter, BottomSheet
│   ├── DownloadManager.kt
│   ├── CatalogFetcher.kt
│   └── CatalogRefresher.kt
├── settings/             # Responsive Switch Settings
│   ├── ui/               # SettingsActivity, Fragments
│   └── SettingsViewModel.kt
├── work/                 # CatalogRefreshWorker
├── repositories/         # Storage + GameRomResolver
│   ├── Storage.kt        # Paths per hackId
│   └── GameRomResolver.kt # Single ROM resolver (vanilla_* vs hackId)
├── retroview/            # Emulation (from Ludere)
│   ├── RetroView.kt      # INTERCEPTION: loads patched ROM from cache
│   └── RetroViewUtils.kt
├── views/
│   ├── LibraryActivity.kt     # Switch HOME row, dock, RA profile, vanilla games
│   ├── GameActivity.kt        # Gameplay activity
│   ├── GamepadTesterActivity.kt # Physical/N64 input visualizer
│   ├── BaseRomLibrarySource.kt
│   └── viewmodels/GameActivityViewModel.kt
├── gamepad/              # RadialGamePad — UNCHANGED from Ludere
├── input/                # ControllerInput, InputMapper, N64ControllerMapping
├── utils/                # CorePrefs, RetroViewUtils — UNCHANGED
├── di/AppContainer.kt    # Service Locator
├── retroachievements/    # RA integration
│   ├── data/             # Identity, catalog, install, safe cached profile
│   └── ui/               # Achievements, profile, in-game Switch-style presentation
├── ui/switchui/          # Native Switch-inspired components
│   ├── SwitchHomeRow.kt, SwitchGameCard.kt, SwitchAllGamesCard.kt
│   ├── SwitchGridScreen.kt, SwitchDock.kt, SwitchFooterHints.kt
│   ├── SwitchSidePanel.kt, SwitchDialog.kt, SwitchFocusBorder.kt
│   ├── SfxManager.kt, ThemeManager.kt
├── capture/              # Screen capture, recording, gallery
└── libretrodroid/        # LOCAL GRADLE MODULE (LibretroDroid 0.13.2 + 2 JNI passthroughs)
```

---

## Hard Rules (Non-Negotiable)

1. **No base ROMs** — Never embed, download, or distribute OoT/MM ROMs
2. **No copyrighted content** — Only patches (BPS) and metadata distributed
3. **GPL-3.0 compliance** — Entire app GPL-3.0; keep LICENSE, preserve headers, offer source
4. **Clean-room BPS** — Implemented from public spec only; no code from rom_patcher_js or UniPatcher
5. **DRY** — Extract shared logic into `utils/`, `patcher/`, `di/`
6. **Modular** — Small focused classes/functions, single responsibility
7. **No emojis** in code, file paths, resource names, technical output
8. **i18n mandatory** — All strings in `strings.xml` (pt-BR default, en, es)
9. **Performance** — Default `config_load_bytes=false`; stream from file; avoid loading 32-64MB ROMs into heap
10. **RetroView interception** — ONLY place ROM bytes reach core is `RetroView.kt` → `GLRetroViewData`
11. **Storage paths keyed by hackId** — Isolated `rom_<hackId>`, `sram_<hackId>`, `state_<hackId>`
12. **Catalog schema versioning** — `catalogVersion` integer; handle migrations gracefully
13. **Selective migration** — Copy from Ludere only specified modules
14. **Gamepad layout FROZEN** — RadialGamePad layout measured for OoT/MM; no changes without approval
15. **No telemetry without opt-in** — No analytics, crash reporting, or network calls except user-initiated
16. **Validate all inputs** — ROM checksums, patch checksums, catalog JSON schema, file sizes
20. **RA credentials never logged** — Stored only in EncryptedSharedPreferences (`ra_secure_prefs`)
21. **RA hash from final patched ROM** — Computed at install time after patch applied
22. **Leaderboards never overlaid on gameplay** — Only via GameActivity in-game menu
23. **Hardcore mode defaults OFF** — Until RAdmin User-Agent validated
24. **License notices** — rcheevos (MIT) license in `app/src/main/cpp/rcheevos/LICENSE`
25. **System notifications opt-in default ON** — Requires POST_NOTIFICATIONS on API 33+

---

## For Hack Authors

See **docs/CATALOG.md** for JSON catalog schema and **docs/catalog.example.json** for ready-to-adapt example.

Required fields for catalog entry:
- `id`, `name`, `description`, `author`, `version`
- `baseRom.name`, `baseRom.gameCode`, `baseRom.versionByte`, `baseRom.checksums.crc32`
- `patch.url`, `patch.filename`, `patch.size`, `patch.checksums.crc32`
- Optional: `coverImageUrl`, `tags`, `compatibleCores`, `ocarinaSongs`

Submit PRs with `catalog.json` following the schema.

---

## Build Instructions

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zonaro/zelda64player.git
cd zelda64player
./gradlew assembleDebug
```

First build downloads Libretro cores to `app/src/main/jniLibs` (needs internet):
- `mupen64plus_next` (GLES3) from buildbot.libretro.com
- `parallel_n64` from self-built rolling release (GitHub Actions) or buildbot nightly fallback

---

## Usage Quick-Start

1. Open **Settings** → **Import Base ROM** and select your legally-owned OoT or MM ROM (.z64/.v64/.n64)
2. Browse the **Store** → view available hacks and download one
3. App validates base ROM checksum, downloads BPS/ZIP patch, applies it, launches game
4. To play vanilla base ROM without patches, select it from Library screen
5. For Auto-Ocarina, start a game and open pause menu — HUD auto-plays songs
